categorias_que.rastreador: A public list recognizes it as tracking: it is used to follow you from one site to the next.
categorias_que.publicidad: It is on the advertising lists: it shows you ads, or measures them.
categorias_que.telemetria: Usage data a program sends back to its maker.
categorias_que.esperado: What a computer needs to work: system updates, certificates, the system’s own security and connectivity checks, time, recognized messaging and video calls, and what GUARDIANA needs for its license.
categorias_que.desconocido: No open tracking list knows it. It does not mean it is suspicious.
categorias_que.red_local: Devices in your home finding each other. It does not go out to the internet.
categorias_que.entrega: A network that carries other companies’ content. Not the destination: the road.
categorias_que.de_empresa: Its owner is known (the next column names the company) and no list marks it as tracking or advertising, but the name does not say what it is for. A label, never a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_anuncios: No list has it yet, but the name carries a technical term from ad auctions (prebid, rtb, ssp, dsp, cookie syncing). The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_pago: A payment or a subscription at that company: the name carries “checkout”, “pay”, “billing” or similar. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_cuenta: Signing in or your account data at that company: the name carries “login”, “accounts”, “auth” or similar. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_medicion: Counts what you do in its app or site, for the company itself: the name carries “analytics”, “metrics”, “events”, “pixel” or similar. No public list marks it as tracking; the name says so.
categorias_que.pista_notificaciones: The notifications that reach your device: the name carries “push”, “notifications” or similar. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_actualizaciones: Downloading updates or the installer: the name carries “update”, “download”, “release” or similar. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_seguridad: Security checks of the browser or the system: the name carries “safebrowsing”, “smartscreen”, “captcha” or similar. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_correo: Your email: the name carries “mail”, “smtp” or “imap”. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_mensajes: Chat or messaging of that company: the name carries “chat”, “messages” or similar. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_sincronizacion: Syncs or keeps a copy in the cloud: the name carries “drive” or “backup”. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_contenido: Images, video, files or fonts the page needs to display: the name carries “cdn”, “static”, “img”, “media” or similar. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_configuracion: The program asks for its settings or checks options: the name carries “config”, “settings”, “flags” or similar. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_app: The program or app talking to its own company’s server in order to work: the name carries “api”, “gateway”, “backend” or similar. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_web: That company’s site or app, the one you opened: the name is its domain or starts with “www”. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.sector: A {sector} website: what it does, from our open list of sectors. It says what it is, not whether to trust it.

cli.uso:
Usage:
  guardiana observe [--listen IP:PORT] [--upstream IP[:PORT]]... [--db PATH] [--canary] [--open] [--no-panel] [--panel-listen IP:PORT]
  guardiana ledger [--check | --wipe | --self | --last N] [--db PATH]
  guardiana export [--csv | --json] [--out FILE] [--device ID] [--category C] [--signal S] [--verdict V] [--limit N] [--db PATH]
  guardiana dns [--status | --apply --yes | --restore] [--db PATH]
  guardiana licencia [clave KEY | comprobar]
  guardiana trampa [crear | lista | quitar ID]   (trap files: a name that only exists inside)
  guardiana apps [--seconds N] [--crudo]   (Windows: which program asks for each name, watch only)
  guardiana verify [--json] [--certificado FILE.json]
  guardiana certificado [--mes YYYY-MM | --desde YYYY-MM-DD --hasta YYYY-MM-DD] [--dominios] [--empresa NAME] [--out FOLDER]   (flow certificate)
  guardiana reglas [deshacer ID | deshacer-hoy]
  guardiana informe               (weekly home report)
  guardiana hogar [status | on | off]
  guardiana service [install | uninstall | start | stop | status]
  guardiana panel                (opens the panel in the browser)
  guardiana comunicaciones       (Communications, chat and calls, in your browser; Linux and Mac)
  guardiana menu [--choice N]     (interactive test menu)
  guardiana version

cli.observe.sin_arriba: The DNS of your network ({upstream}) has not answered for a minute. GUARDIANA gives this computer its DNS back as it was, so you keep your internet, and will ask again every minute.

cli.dns.estado.guardiana_primero: This computer’s queries go to GUARDIANA (127.0.0.1).
cli.dns.aplicado_panel: Done. This PC now goes through GUARDIANA (127.0.0.1). It used to resolve with: {originales}. It can be undone in “Status”.
cli.dns.consentimiento_si: To accept, repeat the command with --yes.
cli.dns.reserva_secundario: The resolver you have now stays as the secondary: if GUARDIANA stops, the computer keeps resolving through it.
cli.dns.solo_guardiana: On this computer GUARDIANA becomes the only resolver. That is what stops any query that goes through the system DNS slipping past it: systemd-resolved picks among the servers it has, it does not ask them in order, so leaving the old one as a second would mean part of the queries would never be seen. The service comes back by itself if it stops, and guardiana dns --restore puts everything back exactly as it was.
cli.dns.solo_guardiana_windows: On this computer GUARDIANA becomes the only DNS, over IPv6 too. That way no query that goes through the system DNS slips past it, and Edge does not go off to an encrypted DNS of its own. GUARDIANA keeps asking the servers you had, from the inside. panel.reglas_lead: No rule exists unless you create it. Every block records who decided it and when. Undoing never deletes: it records that it was undone.

panel.reglas_ninguna: There are no rules. GUARDIANA only watches.
panel.leyenda_desconocido: “Local network” is the devices of your home finding each other: it does not go out to the internet. “Delivery” is a network that carries other companies’ content: not the destination, the road. “Its site”, “your account”, “its server”, “content”, “settings”, “measurement”… is what the name itself says (www, login, api, cdn, config, analytics…): a hint, not a check. “Service” is a name of a known company that no list marks and whose name does not say what it is for. “Unclassified” means that no public list knows it, and neither does our company list; not that it is suspicious. “Sport”, “news”, “banking”… is what a well-known website does, from our open list of sectors.
panel.leyenda_colores: The three colors of the category. Green: normal, what a service needs to work (its website, its server, your account, updates, content, your home network). Orange: worth a look; it measures what you do, serves ads or nobody knows it (advertising, telemetry, measurement, ads, unclassified). Red: alert; a public list recognizes it as tracking, the company is registered as a data broker, or it tries to evade monitoring. It is a way of reading the category, not a verdict: click the label to learn what it means, and allow or block each row with its switch.

panel.av_sancion_ftc_avast: According to the FTC, Avast collected the browsing history of users of its antivirus and extensions, kept it indefinitely and sold it to more than 100 companies through its subsidiary Jumpshot, while claiming to protect their privacy. The order bans it from selling or licensing browsing data for advertising and requires it to delete the data passed to Jumpshot, notify those affected and pay $16.5 million to compensate consumers.
panel.av_sancion_ftc_avg: The FTC order against Avast includes AVG products (same group) among those covered by the duty to notify users. It is not a second penalty: same case, same payment.
panel.av_sancion_uoou_avast: The Czech data protection authority fined Avast Software for processing personal data without a legal basis: it passed its users’ browsing data to its subsidiary Jumpshot, data that allowed at least some of them to be identified, and did not inform them properly. In 2025 a court upheld the breaches but annulled the amount (see the ruling).
panel.av_sancion_msp_avast: The Prague Municipal Court confirmed that Avast committed both breaches, but annulled the figure of about 100 million affected users and the confirmation of the amount, and sent the case back to the authority to recalculate it. Until then, the 351 million korunas are not a final amount.
panel.av_sancion_cma_norton: The UK competition and consumer authority investigated automatic subscription renewals. Norton undertook to let customers cancel with a pro-rata refund after renewal, to state the renewal price up front and not to present the first price as a discount. There was no fine and no admission of wrongdoing.
panel.av_sancion_cma_mcafee: The UK competition and consumer authority investigated automatic subscription renewals. McAfee undertook to let customers cancel with a pro-rata refund after renewal, to simplify refunds and to state the renewal price up front. There was no fine and no admission of wrongdoing.
panel.av_sancion_bis_kaspersky: The US Department of Commerce banned Kaspersky from selling its antivirus in the country and, from 29 September 2024, from updating it, on national-security grounds. It is not a fine, and people who keep using it commit no offence.
panel.av_sancion_canada_kaspersky: The Government of Canada blocked and removed Kaspersky applications from official mobile phones. It only covers government devices.
panel.av_sancion_bsi_kaspersky: Germany’s Federal Office for Information Security officially warned against using Kaspersky’s antivirus and recommended replacing it. It is neither a fine nor a ban. A German administrative court rejected Kaspersky’s urgent application to withdraw the warning.
panel.av_sancion_dhs_kaspersky: The US Department of Homeland Security ordered federal government agencies to identify and remove Kaspersky products from their systems. It only covers the federal government.

The company behind the service is kept apart from the network that serves it: a server rented on Amazon Web Services is not Amazon’s.

panel.lente_estado_dns: This computer's DNS does not go through GUARDIANA yet.
panel.lente_registro_lead: Every query on record, with who decided what.
panel.lente_registro_s1: The log is your home's memory: every name asked of the internet, when, from which device and what was done with it.
panel.lente_registro_s2: Each row is chained to the one before. If anyone changed a single one, the check would say so.
panel.lente_foto_lead: What this computer asked of the internet in the last minute, by category.
panel.lente_foto_s1: A still picture: every name requested in the last 60 seconds, each in exactly one category.
panel.lente_foto_s2: That is why the breakdown adds up to the total: what the lists do not recognize goes to “Unclassified”, it is not lost.
panel.lente_foto_vacio: This computer has not asked the internet for anything in the last minute.
panel.lente_maxima_sub: Blocks the trackers, advertising and telemetry the open lists know, across the whole home.
panel.lente_informe_lead: Your home's last seven days, by device.
panel.lente_informe_s1: A summary of the week with real figures from the log, no rounding.
panel.lente_informe_s2: Nothing leaves home unless you share it.
panel.lente_informe_ejemplo: The full weekly report is part of Plus.
panel.lente_ct_lead: Which companies each program talks to, and what changed with each update.
panel.lente_ct_s1: A contract is the list of companies a program normally talks to.
panel.lente_ct_s2: When an update adds a new company, it shows in amber. It is not an alarm: you decide whether to keep it or block it.

panel.lente_ct_e_fijado: Fixed contract: anything not in it is blocked automatically and recorded.
panel.lente_revision_lead: What Windows says about this computer, read without changing anything.
panel.lente_revision_s1: A check-up reads how this computer is protected: who can get in, what starts on its own and where your internet goes out.
panel.lente_revision_s2: GUARDIANA only reads: it changes and installs nothing. Anything that appears after the first check-up is marked as new.
panel.lente_revision_nunca: This computer has not been checked yet.
panel.lente_ia_lead: Which AI services each device talks to, and when.
panel.lente_ia_s1: An AI agent on your computer works with your keys: your folders, your accounts, your network.
panel.lente_ia_s2: Set how far it may go and GUARDIANA tells you when it talks to anything outside that scope.
panel.lente_av_lead: Which addresses your antivirus talks to, and what its maker says about each one.
panel.lente_av_s1: Your antivirus is the program with the most access to your computer: it checks all your files.
panel.lente_av_s2: Someone independent has to watch the watcher. GUARDIANA only looks: your antivirus keeps protecting you.
panel.lente_disp_lead: What each device at home did, in totals.
panel.lente_disp_s1: Every device that uses GUARDIANA as its DNS shows up here with its totals.
panel.lente_disp_s2: A device's detail is visible only from that device, unless its owner shares it.
panel.lente_vg_lead: What the system records about the camera, microphone, startup and privacy settings.
panel.lente_vg_s1: GUARDIANA keeps watching, and only watching, what the system itself records.
panel.lente_vg_s2: It changes nothing, reads the content of nothing, and none of this leaves your computer.
panel.lente_vp_lead: What each program does on the network, seen from outside.
panel.lente_vp_s1: Which companies each program talks to, how much it uploads and downloads.
panel.lente_vp_s2: Without opening anything: GUARDIANA counts, it does not decrypt.
panel.lente_sabe_lead: Everything this program stores, where, and what it has sent out.
panel.lente_sabe_s1: What GUARDIANA records stays on this computer, in a single file.
panel.lente_sabe_s2: Below, every connection GUARDIANA itself made out of it, with its reason.
panel.lente_id_lead: Who is behind every name your programs connect to.
panel.lente_id_s1: GUARDIANA says who is behind each name, how sure it is and why.
panel.lente_id_s2: From data inside the program: it asks nobody about each name. A server rented on Amazon is not Amazon's.
panel.lente_cert_lead: A signed certificate of your data flows, and the letters to exercise your rights.
panel.lente_cert_s1: The certificate states, by company, who this computer asked for in a period, with no IP addresses and no history.
panel.lente_cert_s2: This computer makes it from its chained log and you keep it: GUARDIANA sends it to nobody.
panel.lente_cert_pendiente: The figures appear once you make the certificate for a period.
panel.lente_borrado_lead: A letter ready to send, citing the law where you live, to each company that keeps your data.
panel.lente_borrado_s1: Almost every country with a data protection law requires companies to delete your personal data when you ask.
panel.lente_borrado_s2: GUARDIANA prepares the letter and counts the deadline; you do the sending.
panel.lente_exp_lead: Every request to a company, with its legal deadline and what happened.
panel.lente_exp_s1: GUARDIANA counts the days of each request and tells you when the deadline is up.
panel.lente_exp_s2: If they do not answer, it prepares the complaint to the authority. Everything stays on this computer.
panel.lente_reglas_lead: What is blocked and what is allowed, and who decided it.
panel.lente_reglas_s1: No rule exists unless you create it.
panel.lente_reglas_s2: Every block records who decided it and when. Undoing never deletes: it records that it was undone.
panel.lente_hx_lead: Three tools that work here, without any file leaving this computer.
panel.lente_hx_s1: Blackout mode blocks everything that is not essential; Clean file removes the hidden data in a photo or a document.
panel.lente_hx_s2: And before installing, see who signed the installer. GUARDIANA looks at the file and does not keep it.
panel.lente_hogar_lead: This PC as the DNS guardian of the home Wi-Fi, without installing anything on other devices.
panel.lente_hogar_s1: With Home Mode, phones, the TV and everything on the Wi-Fi go through GUARDIANA.
panel.lente_hogar_s2: Each device connects once, with a QR code or from the router.
panel.lente_lic_lead: Your plan, your devices and every time GUARDIANA talked to the license server.
panel.lente_lic_s1: Without a license GUARDIANA does not switch off: it moves to Free and keeps watching this computer.
panel.lente_lic_s2: Plus (monthly, yearly or Lifetime) adds the whole history, several devices, alerts, automatic blocks and reports.
panel.lente_verify_lead: Facts, not promises: this program's signature and public record.
panel.lente_verify_s1: The same thing guardiana verify prints: if something does not add up, it shows here.
panel.lente_verify_s2: The signature proves who made this program; the public record, that it is the same version everyone gets.
panel.lente_estado_lead: How GUARDIANA is running on this computer.
panel.lente_estado_s1: GUARDIANA answers this computer's DNS queries and records them.
panel.lente_estado_s2: The lists say what is tracking, advertising or telemetry, and they update on their own.
panel.lente_ficha_lead: Who it is, what it does, and how often your home called it.
panel.lente_ficha_s1: One profile per company: its headquarters, its trade and what your home exchanged with it.
panel.lente_ficha_s2: If it keeps your data, you can ask it to delete them with a letter ready to send.
